svg.text: PR #1 · Tests, CI, bundled styles, example matrix, Starstruck license, glyph and box-fit checks
check_svg.py and action.yml shipped untested, with one palette and nothing enforcing the check on this repo;
now 173 tests, six styles, glyph/box-fit checks and a self-applied workflow make every claim in the README checked.
BEFORE
AFTER

g.text: ci.yml: three printf-built SVGs piped through the validator

svg.text: no tests: check_text budgets, exit codes, action shell unverified
one palette; a re-skin meant editing every fill/stroke by hand
emoji or icon glyphs passed and rendered as boxes in review
text overrunning its rect was invisible to the canvas check
every PR needed an SVG, even a one-line lockfile bump
this repo never ran its own check on its own PRs
recipe told agents to curl a v1 tag that did not exist
README described behavior nothing verified

g.text: An untested checker enforcing rules on other repos
regressions in check_svg.py or action.yml would ship silently
ci.yml: pytest 3.10–3.13, actionlint + shellcheck, action end to end

svg.text: test_action.py drives action.yml offline with a fake gh
six style/*.json, one 14-slot order; --style nord re-skins by index
check_glyphs(): chars outside style["glyphs"] are hard errors
check_box_fit(): text past its rect edge warns
min-changed-lines skips tiny PRs; linguist-generated files don't count
visual-pr.yml runs the action on this repo — this file is its proof

g.text: Starstruck: Apache-2.0 plus a request, not a condition
SnarkCheck runs in a 2 s daemon thread; never changes the exit code
Every README claim has a test that fails when it stops being true
test_docs.py binds README, action.yml, SPEC.md, style/ and LICENSE together

svg.text: The v1 tag the recipe curls still does not exist until this merges; and the glyph allowlist is a curated guess at what fonts render, not a font-file lookup.
